svg.aria-label: synthwerk-studio is the public site, the landing page builder and the admin dashboard of the synthwerk (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk) stack. It is also the app shell for SDK apps. Today it is a skeleton, cleaned to the bone on purpose. The bones are good.
